description.en: The configuration file for catalog backup.

description.zh:
Catalog备份是否使用Backint。

- true：Catalog备份使用Backint。
- false：Catalog备份不使用Backint。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use Backint to back up catalogs. Valid values:

*   true: Backint is used to back up catalogs.
*   false: Backint is not used to back up catalogs.
The ID of the SAP HANA instance.
The configuration file for data backup.

description.zh:
是否开启自动日志备份。
- **true**：开启自动日志备份。
- **false**：不开启自动日志备份。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic log backup. Valid values:

*   **true**: enables automatic log backup.
*   **false**: disables automatic log backup.
The configuration file for log backup.

description.zh: 日志备份间隔时间，单位秒。
description.en: The interval at which logs are backed up. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
是否日志备份到Backint。

- true：将日志备份到Backint。
- false：不备份到Backint。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use Backint to back up logs. Valid values:

*   true: Backint is used to back up logs.
*   false: Backint is not used to back up logs.
The ID of the backup vault.

title.zh: 更新SAP HANA数据库备份参数

descriptions.zh: 若要更新数据库备份保留时间，请调用UpdateHanaRetentionSetting。
descriptions.en: You can call the UpdateHanaRetentionSetting operation to update the backup retention period of a database.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr update-hana-backup-setting --vault-id v-0005n000000rluw5 --cluster-id cl-000ezvg0000008znz --database-name SYSTEMDB --enable-auto-log-backup true --data-backup-parameter-file /usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param --log-backup-parameter-file /usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param --log-backup-using-backint true --log-backup-timeout 900 --catalog-backup-using-backint true --catalog-backup-parameter-file /usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr UpdateHanaBackupSetting --region cn-hangzhou --LogBackupTimeout 900 --LogBackupUsingBackint true --ClusterId 'cl-000ezvg0000008znz' --LogBackupParameterFile '/usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param' --CatalogBackupParameterFile '/usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param' --DatabaseName SYSTEMDB --DataBackupParameterFile '/usr/sap/SID/SYS/global/hdb/opt/hdbconfig/param' --CatalogBackupUsingBackint true --VaultId 'v-0005n000000rluw5' --EnableAutoLogBackup true
